data.name: Saundra
data.gender_notes: Saundra is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saundra is a feminine name derived from the Old English word 'sundor,' which means 'separate' or 'sound.' Over time, it evolved to mean 'gentle, beautiful sound.' In the Bible, a similar name, Soundra, is not found. The name Saundra carries the meaning “Gentle, beautiful sound” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Saundra usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, beautiful sound and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saundra total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
